summary: Test-writing (red) phase for issue #5: generated OpenAPI Swift client. Committed permanent tests that pin the implementation contract — package wiring (swift-openapi-generator/-runtime, target ColorMatchingOpenAPI), the vendored iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching.json document, all six API surfaces with upstream operationIds/response statuses/bearerAuth, generated-client behavior against a stubbed ClientTransport, and the BearerAuthenticationMiddleware. Tests are intentionally red until the implementation run lands the generated client (expected in this phase). No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; upstream spec sources (viamin/color_matching#113: api_schemas.ex, api_spec.ex, router.ex, controllers) were fetched and used to derive exact generated names, recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client.md. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (10 findings, incl. thin manifest/ranked-results schemas, 200-JSON upload responses vs prose-implied 204, exposure_duration vs exposure_duration_seconds, anyOf patterns that degrade under OpenAPIKit parsing) are documented for the PR description.
